content_blocks.heading_text: Project Management Careers in Denver's Growing Sectors
content_blocks.text:
Denver's aerospace and defense industry anchors demand for certified project managers, with Lockheed Martin and other major employers managing complex, regulated programs that require PMP® or CAPM® credentials. Beyond defense, healthcare systems like Kaiser Permanente Colorado and Children's Hospital Colorado depend on certified PMs to oversee clinical technology deployments and facility expansions. Financial services firms, including Charles Schwab, and telecommunications leaders like Lumen Technologies also actively recruit project managers with formal certification. Visible local infrastructure initiatives—from the RTD FasTracks Transit Expansion to the Central 70 Project—demonstrate the scale of project management work underway across the Denver metro, creating sustained openings for professionals who can demonstrate standardized PM competency.

The PMP® credential carries real weight in Denver's job market. Many local postings for project management roles list PMP® or CAPM® as preferred or required, reflecting how seriously employers across aerospace, healthcare, and IT sectors value certified professionals. Project manager compensation in the Denver area remains competitive with national urban averages, and those holding a PMP® credential often command above-average pay—a direct payoff for the investment in certification. Completing PMP® Certification Training through Granite PM Academy positions you to meet that employer demand and advance your earning potential in a city where both the credential and your experience matter.

content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Denver

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's credential requirements to confirm you meet both components. Granite PM Academy's admissions team can verify your background and clarify any questions about your work history or academic credentials before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend all sessions synchronously from anywhere, interact directly with active certified practitioners, and receive comprehensive course materials. This formal education satisfies PMI's contact-hour requirement and builds the domain knowledge you'll need for exam success.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing Granite PM Academy's course, submit your official PMP application directly to PMI. Document your project-management experience, confirm your education credentials, and pay the associated PMI exam fee. Our team provides guidance on application requirements so your submission is complete and accurate.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor office hours—to refine your readiness. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner at a time and location convenient to you. Apply the knowledge and frameworks you've learned throughout the course.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, you'll enter a 3-year renewal cycle. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through approved training, work experience, and professional activities. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing learning opportunities to help you accumulate PDUs and stay current in project-management practice while holding your credential.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
